decisions: Identify the measured subject, source dimension basis and key unknowns before building the major form.
Check mass, level, major voids and interfaces first; load only relevant REF sections by task and stage.
evidence_checks: Inspect actual returned views; validate applicable geometry/dependencies. Record unknowns honestly.
reject_if: Known source mismatch or unresolved user defect.

decisions: Derive one roof prototype from a shared ridge profile, body section, eave curve and corner-lift section before tier replication.
Use loft, sweep or a shared-boundary mesh; read only the relevant ancient-roof REF sections when needed.
evidence_checks: Inspect the body section, corner transition, underside and shared seams in fixed views before accepting replication.
reject_if: The roof is a flat slab, a single frustum, or only raises plan-ring corner points.
Body and corner prototypes do not share declared control geometry or contain visible open seams.
